scripts.health: docker inspect --format '{{.Name}} → {{.State.Health.Status}}' $(docker compose --profile all ps -q) 2>/dev/null || echo 'No containers running'
scripts.backup:mysql: docker exec mysql mysqldump -u root -p${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:-rootsecret} ${MYSQL_DB:-devdb} > backups/mysql_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.restore:mysql: cat $FILE | docker exec -i mysql mysql -u root -p${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:-rootsecret} ${MYSQL_DB:-dev}
scripts.update: npm run pull && npm run up
